fullName: TJWA_TC_LSU_NEG_001 - [Negative] Invalid mobile number blocks advancing past Step 1
description:
[Negative] Verify Step 1 of the Sell Used Tractor wizard does not advance to Step 2 (Tractor Details) when an invalid (too-short) mobile number is entered.

Expected: The wizard should remain on Step 1; the Step 2 brand dropdown should not appear.
